chunks: It was in the will of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم to ʿAlī عليه السلام:

"O ʿAlī, when you intend a city or a village, then say when you behold it: O Allah, I ask You for its goodness, and I seek refuge in You from its evil. O Allah, make us beloved to its people, and make the righteous of its people beloved to us."

key_terms.خَيْرَهَا: its goodness, benefit, and favorable aspects
key_terms.شَرِّهَا: its evil, harm, and unfavorable aspects
key_terms.صَالِحِي: the righteous ones among the people
key_terms.قَرْيَةً: a village that one is approaching or entering
key_terms.مَدِينَةً: a city that one is approaching or entering
key_terms.وَصِيَّةِ: a testament or counsel containing important instruction

ai.seo_question: What supplication should be recited when entering a city or village?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a du'a to recite upon approaching a city or village, asking Allah for its good and seeking refuge from its harm. It also asks for mutual affection between the traveler and the righteous inhabitants, reflecting Islamic etiquette in entering new communities.
